chapter: Non-final PDF smoke build and LaTeX compile validation
build_failure_reason: Underscore escaping in artifact filenames (e.g. method_pipeline_figure.mmd). Multiple .tex files contain filenames with underscores interpreted as math subscripts.
notes: P18 detects LaTeX tools, validates scaffold structure, attempts build, and documents underscore-escaping blocker. P19 should fix underscore issues and retry full build.
